$comment: UX-14 (#137): the V2 performance budget, measured by .github/workflows/performance-budget.yml with Lighthouse CI on a production build; tools/performance-budget.mjs turns this file into the Lighthouse CI config and the run summary. Every value is the median of the runs. Sizes are compressed transfer sizes in KiB (1,024 bytes), as Lighthouse reports them; times are milliseconds. `budget` is enforced: the measured value plus a margin, so a regression fails the check. `target` is where each screen should get to (the issue's targets and Lighthouse's 'good' thresholds); it is reported, not enforced, until the screen meets it.
